name: PhilHealth
authority: Republic Act 11223 (Universal Health Care Act) s.10 with PhilHealth Circular 2019-0009 and Advisory 2025-0002 — one 5% premium on the monthly basic salary, floor PHP 10,000, ceiling PHP 100,000, then split: employee = truncate_cent(premium / 2), employer = premium - employee (the published employer table; a half-centavo premium such as basic 15,819 -> 790.95 gives 395.47 / 395.48, not 395.48 twice). The base is the BASIC line, which Advisory 2025-0002 ¶3 keeps whole against undertime, tardiness, leave without pay and absences (the ABSENCE and NO_PAY_LEAVE lines are not subtracted). Applied 2026-09-18: PhilHealth Advisory 2025-0002 ¶3 keys the premium off the basic monthly salary stated in the contract, whole for a mid-month hire or leaver (`person.terms.basic_salary`). Applied 2026-09-18: PhilHealth Advisory 2025-0002 ¶3 keys the premium off the basic monthly salary stated in the contract, whole for a mid-month hire or leaver (`person.terms.basic_salary`). Applied 2026-09-19 (2): The base is the monthly basic salary whatever the pay frequency (`terms.monthly_basic`: a daily or hourly rate carried to the month by the person’s own factor). RA 10361 (Batas Kasambahay) s.30: where a domestic worker earns less than ₱5,000 a month the employer pays the whole premium — the employee share is zero and the employer carries both.
assessed_on: person.terms.monthly_basic / period.month_factor

name: Pag-IBIG Fund (Home Development Mutual Fund)
authority: Republic Act 9679 s.7 with HDMF Circular 460 — 1%/2% employee, 2% employer, monthly compensation ceiling PHP 10,000. Applied 2026-09-18: HDMF Circular 460 keys the contribution off the contractual monthly compensation, whole for a mid-month hire or leaver (`person.terms.basic_salary`, the standing allowances beside it). Applied 2026-09-19 (2): The base is the monthly basic salary whatever the pay frequency (`terms.monthly_basic`: a daily or hourly rate carried to the month by the person’s own factor). RA 10361 (Batas Kasambahay) s.30: where a domestic worker earns less than ₱5,000 a month the employer pays the whole premium — the employee share is zero and the employer carries both.
assessed_on: person.terms.monthly_basic / period.month_factor - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE

name: Withholding Tax on Compensation
authority: NIRC 1997 s.79 with s.24(A)(2)(a) as amended by RA 10963 (TRAIN), Revenue Regulations 11-2018 — revised withholding tax table effective 1 January 2023. The NIRC s.32(B)(7)(e) PHP 90,000 exemption for 13th-month pay is `annual_exempt(code('THIRTEENTH_MONTH_PAY'), year.earned.THIRTEENTH_MONTH_PAY, 90000.0)` in the formula. RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(d) as amended by RR 29-2025 (issued 22 December 2025, in force 6 January 2026): a rice subsidy of up to PHP 2,500 a month is a de minimis benefit outside compensation; the company's `meal` row is that subsidy (its sheet: "MEAL (RICE SUBSIDY)", with any excess booked as `allowance`), so the formula takes it out of the base up to PHP 30,000 a year — `annual_exempt(code('meal'), year.earned.meal, 30000.0)`, the monthly ceiling stated as its annual sum, exact for a level subsidy and reconciled by the year-end rung otherwise. The `bonus` allowance shares that ceiling and is not yet pooled with it (gap 105). The monthly and semi-monthly rungs relieve the SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG employee shares deducted in the same period (`produced.<code>.employee_this_period`, RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(B) as amended); only the year-end rung reads the year's shares. The SEMI-MONTHLY column (₱10,417 / 16,667 / 33,333 / 83,333 / 333,333; ₱937.50 / 4,270.70 / 16,770.70 / 91,770.70) governs a base paid in two instalments (`period.instalments == 2`); the MONTHLY column everything else. Applied 2026-09-18: RA 9504 (RR 11-2018): a statutory minimum-wage earner (basic at or below the region’s floor) is withheld on neither the basic wage, overtime, night shift differential nor holiday pay; the ₱90,000 exclusion is one pool across 13th-month pay and the bonus (NIRC s.32(B)(7)(e)); the de minimis meal allowance is exempt to 30% of the basic minimum wage (RR 29-2025); the MPF employee share relieves the taxable base beside the Regular SS share. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): NIRC s.32(B)(6)(a)–(b): retirement benefits under RA 7641 and separation pay for a cause beyond the employee’s control are excluded from gross income; s.24(A)(2) / RR 10-2008: a minimum wage earner’s statutory minimum wage, holiday pay, overtime pay and night shift differential are exempt (`terms.monthly_basic <= wage_floor`). RR 11-2018 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(d): the rice subsidy (the `meal` row) is de minimis to ₱2,000 a month, the excess taxable — a monthly figure, not a share of the annual minimum wage; the bonus is read once, through the 90,000 exemption, never also through the catalogue. The semi-monthly rung selector nets the MPF share with the SSS share. Applied 2026-09-19 (3): RR 11-2018 Annex E, the weekly column, for a payslip of a weekly-paying company (`period.instalments >= 4`: the month’s four or five weeks): nothing to ₱4,808; 15% over 4,808; 432.60 + 20% over 7,692; 1,971.20 + 25% over 15,385; 7,740.45 + 30% over 38,462; 42,355.65 + 35% over 153,846 — the annual schedule over fifty-two, as the Annex prints it. The daily column is for a payroll paid every day, a cadence the runs do not offer.

name: Withholding Tax on Compensation
authority: NIRC 1997 s.79 with s.24(A)(2)(a) as amended by RA 10963 (TRAIN), Revenue Regulations 11-2018 — revised withholding tax table effective 1 January 2023. The NIRC s.32(B)(7)(e) PHP 90,000 exemption for 13th-month pay is `annual_exempt(code('THIRTEENTH_MONTH_PAY'), year.earned.THIRTEENTH_MONTH_PAY, 90000.0)` in the formula. RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(d) as amended by RR 11-2018: a rice subsidy of up to PHP 2,000 a month is a de minimis benefit outside compensation; the company's `meal` row is that subsidy (its sheet: "MEAL (RICE SUBSIDY)"), so the formula takes it out of the base up to PHP 24,000 a year — `annual_exempt(code('meal'), year.earned.meal, 24000.0)`, the monthly ceiling stated as its annual sum. The `bonus` allowance shares that ceiling and is not yet pooled with it (gap 105). The monthly and semi-monthly rungs relieve the SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG employee shares deducted in the same period (`produced.<code>.employee_this_period`, RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(B) as amended); only the year-end rung reads the year's shares. The SEMI-MONTHLY column (₱10,417 / 16,667 / 33,333 / 83,333 / 333,333; ₱937.50 / 4,270.70 / 16,770.70 / 91,770.70) governs a base paid in two instalments (`period.instalments == 2`); the MONTHLY column everything else. Applied 2026-09-18: RA 9504 (RR 11-2018): a statutory minimum-wage earner (basic at or below the region’s floor) is withheld on neither the basic wage, overtime, night shift differential nor holiday pay; the ₱90,000 exclusion is one pool across 13th-month pay and the bonus (NIRC s.32(B)(7)(e)); the de minimis meal allowance is exempt to 30% of the basic minimum wage (RR 29-2025); the MPF employee share relieves the taxable base beside the Regular SS share. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): NIRC s.32(B)(6)(a)–(b): retirement benefits under RA 7641 and separation pay for a cause beyond the employee’s control are excluded from gross income; s.24(A)(2) / RR 10-2008: a minimum wage earner’s statutory minimum wage, holiday pay, overtime pay and night shift differential are exempt (`terms.monthly_basic <= wage_floor`). RR 11-2018 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(d): the rice subsidy (the `meal` row) is de minimis to ₱2,000 a month, the excess taxable — a monthly figure, not a share of the annual minimum wage; the bonus is read once, through the 90,000 exemption, never also through the catalogue. The semi-monthly rung selector nets the MPF share with the SSS share. Applied 2026-09-19 (3): RR 11-2018 Annex E, the weekly column, for a payslip of a weekly-paying company (`period.instalments >= 4`: the month’s four or five weeks): nothing to ₱4,808; 15% over 4,808; 432.60 + 20% over 7,692; 1,971.20 + 25% over 15,385; 7,740.45 + 30% over 38,462; 42,355.65 + 35% over 153,846 — the annual schedule over fifty-two, as the Annex prints it. The daily column is for a payroll paid every day, a cadence the runs do not offer.

name: Withholding Tax on Compensation
authority: NIRC 1997 s.79 with s.24(A)(2)(a) as amended by RA 10963 (TRAIN), Revenue Regulations 11-2018 — revised withholding tax table effective 1 January 2023. The NIRC s.32(B)(7)(e) PHP 90,000 exemption for 13th-month pay is `annual_exempt(code('THIRTEENTH_MONTH_PAY'), year.earned.THIRTEENTH_MONTH_PAY, 90000.0)` in the formula. RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(d) as amended by RR 29-2025 (issued 22 December 2025, in force 6 January 2026): a rice subsidy of up to PHP 2,500 a month is a de minimis benefit outside compensation; the company's `meal` row is that subsidy (its sheet: "MEAL (RICE SUBSIDY)", with any excess booked as `allowance`), so the formula takes it out of the base up to PHP 30,000 a year — `annual_exempt(code('meal'), year.earned.meal, 30000.0)`, the monthly ceiling stated as its annual sum, exact for a level subsidy and reconciled by the year-end rung otherwise. The `bonus` allowance shares that ceiling and is not yet pooled with it (gap 105). The monthly and semi-monthly rungs relieve the SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG employee shares deducted in the same period (`produced.<code>.employee_this_period`, RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(B) as amended); only the year-end rung reads the year's shares. The SEMI-MONTHLY column (₱10,417 / 16,667 / 33,333 / 83,333 / 333,333; ₱937.50 / 4,270.70 / 16,770.70 / 91,770.70) governs a base paid in two instalments (`period.instalments == 2`); the MONTHLY column everything else. Applied 2026-09-18: RA 9504 (RR 11-2018): a statutory minimum-wage earner (basic at or below the region’s floor) is withheld on neither the basic wage, overtime, night shift differential nor holiday pay; the ₱90,000 exclusion is one pool across 13th-month pay and the bonus (NIRC s.32(B)(7)(e)); the de minimis meal allowance is exempt to 30% of the basic minimum wage (RR 29-2025); the MPF employee share relieves the taxable base beside the Regular SS share. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): NIRC s.32(B)(6)(a)–(b): retirement benefits under RA 7641 and separation pay for a cause beyond the employee’s control are excluded from gross income; s.24(A)(2) / RR 10-2008: a minimum wage earner’s statutory minimum wage, holiday pay, overtime pay and night shift differential are exempt (`terms.monthly_basic <= wage_floor`). RR 11-2018 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(d): the rice subsidy (the `meal` row) is de minimis to ₱2,000 a month, the excess taxable — a monthly figure, not a share of the annual minimum wage; the bonus is read once, through the 90,000 exemption, never also through the catalogue. The semi-monthly rung selector nets the MPF share with the SSS share. Applied 2026-09-19 (3): RR 11-2018 Annex E, the weekly column, for a payslip of a weekly-paying company (`period.instalments >= 4`: the month’s four or five weeks): nothing to ₱4,808; 15% over 4,808; 432.60 + 20% over 7,692; 1,971.20 + 25% over 15,385; 7,740.45 + 30% over 38,462; 42,355.65 + 35% over 153,846 — the annual schedule over fifty-two, as the Annex prints it. The daily column is for a payroll paid every day, a cadence the runs do not offer.

name: Withholding Tax on Compensation
authority: NIRC 1997 s.79 with s.24(A)(2)(a) as amended by RA 10963 (TRAIN), Revenue Regulations 11-2018 — revised withholding tax table effective 1 January 2023. The NIRC s.32(B)(7)(e) PHP 90,000 exemption for 13th-month pay is `annual_exempt(code('THIRTEENTH_MONTH_PAY'), year.earned.THIRTEENTH_MONTH_PAY, 90000.0)` in the formula. RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(d) as amended by RR 29-2025 (issued 22 December 2025, in force 6 January 2026): a rice subsidy of up to PHP 2,500 a month is a de minimis benefit outside compensation; the company's `meal` row is that subsidy (its sheet: "MEAL (RICE SUBSIDY)", with any excess booked as `allowance`), so the formula takes it out of the base up to PHP 30,000 a year — `annual_exempt(code('meal'), year.earned.meal, 30000.0)`, the monthly ceiling stated as its annual sum, exact for a level subsidy and reconciled by the year-end rung otherwise. The `bonus` allowance shares that ceiling and is not yet pooled with it (gap 105). The monthly and semi-monthly rungs relieve the SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG employee shares deducted in the same period (`produced.<code>.employee_this_period`, RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(B) as amended); only the year-end rung reads the year's shares. The SEMI-MONTHLY column (₱10,417 / 16,667 / 33,333 / 83,333 / 333,333; ₱937.50 / 4,270.70 / 16,770.70 / 91,770.70) governs a base paid in two instalments (`period.instalments == 2`); the MONTHLY column everything else. Applied 2026-09-18: RA 9504 (RR 11-2018): a statutory minimum-wage earner (basic at or below the region’s floor) is withheld on neither the basic wage, overtime, night shift differential nor holiday pay; the ₱90,000 exclusion is one pool across 13th-month pay and the bonus (NIRC s.32(B)(7)(e)); the de minimis meal allowance is exempt to 30% of the basic minimum wage (RR 29-2025); the MPF employee share relieves the taxable base beside the Regular SS share. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): NIRC s.32(B)(6)(a)–(b): retirement benefits under RA 7641 and separation pay for a cause beyond the employee’s control are excluded from gross income; s.24(A)(2) / RR 10-2008: a minimum wage earner’s statutory minimum wage, holiday pay, overtime pay and night shift differential are exempt (`terms.monthly_basic <= wage_floor`). RR 11-2018 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(d): the rice subsidy (the `meal` row) is de minimis to ₱2,000 a month, the excess taxable — a monthly figure, not a share of the annual minimum wage; the bonus is read once, through the 90,000 exemption, never also through the catalogue. The semi-monthly rung selector nets the MPF share with the SSS share. Applied 2026-09-19 (3): RR 11-2018 Annex E, the weekly column, for a payslip of a weekly-paying company (`period.instalments >= 4`: the month’s four or five weeks): nothing to ₱4,808; 15% over 4,808; 432.60 + 20% over 7,692; 1,971.20 + 25% over 15,385; 7,740.45 + 30% over 38,462; 42,355.65 + 35% over 153,846 — the annual schedule over fifty-two, as the Annex prints it.
